messages:
Maya SRE: Postmortem follow-up: recurring p95 latency blips for text-gen in us-west (3x in 7 days). Need owners, timelines, and a temporary SLO adjustment so customer pages stay healthy.

Priya Anand: I'll own kvcache tuning and eviction policy changes. ETA Tue EOD.

Dan Smith: I'll add per-pool p95 panels and request-size heatmap by Mon noon. Will also tighten alerts.

Rachel P: Propose a 24h emergency SLO override: p95 200ms -> 260ms, auto-rollback if extra error-budget burn >5%. Pause risky rollouts during window.

Maya SRE: I'll draft the override in the runbook and add rollout gating. Will post PR this afternoon.

ops-bot: Created ticket RED-7901 "us-west text-gen p95 follow-up" and assigned owners.

Dan Smith: Grafana query I'll use for p95-by-pool: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="text-gen"}[5m])) by (le, pool)).

Priya Anand: After tuning, if spikes persist we'll enforce per-pool quotas and a max-batch limit.

Maya SRE: Plan recap: Priya -> kvcache tuning (Tue EOD), Dan -> dashboards/alerts (Mon noon), Maya -> SLO override PR (today), Rachel -> customer comms + monitor error-budget. Reconvene Wed 10am to decide permanent SLO changes.

Rachel P: Thanks. I'll monitor error-budget burn and post updates here.

Maya SRE: Adding a P2 alert: sustained p95 delta >30ms for 15m -> page oncall with runbook link. Closing with RED-7901 action list.
